title: Enterprise Connectivity: accepted-source pricing handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: When the corresponding accounting action is due, this entry governs accepted-source pricing. The accountant completes the network source pricing assessment under the selected customer acceptance, recording an approved correct net subtotal. Its assessment receipt confirms the reviewed price is available.

## Handling condition
Before pricing the assisted invoice, the customer must personally file its exact net-ceiling acceptance.

## Invocation
price_network_84b98f50 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Accepted-source pricing uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Accepted-source pricing uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Authoritative source evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Accepted-source pricing uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact export or net invoice identifier copied from find_network_events or the preceding invoice receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id
Accepted-source pricing uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Pricing review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter request_id
Accepted-source pricing uses `request_id`: Id class — Customer acceptance identifier copied from the actual preceding authorization receipt.

## Parameter net_amount
Accepted-source pricing uses `net_amount`: Fixed-format class — Accepted or assessed net subtotal in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number with two-decimal precision, supplied after final half-up rounding and stored at two decimals.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary with event_id (string business-event identifier) and net_amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); this receipt confirms completion.
